name: CESM2 Large Ensemble (CESM2-LE2 / SMILE)
access: Output from the Community Earth System Model Version 2 Large Ensemble community project (CESM2-LE2) are available from the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Climate Data Gateway at https://www.cesm.ucar.edu/community-projects/lens2/data-sets

scales.note: CESM2-LE2 40-member large ensemble regridded to 1x1 degree and 3-day means spanning 1950–2100.
